lore.short_description: You can choose to go into a frenzy when you rage. Doing so grants a bonus action melee attack, but causes 1 level of exhaustion when the rage ends.
lore.full_text: Starting when you choose this path at 3rd level, you can go into a frenzy when you rage. If you do so, for the duration of your rage you can make a single melee weapon attack as a bonus action on each of your turns after this one. When your rage ends, you suffer one level of exhaustion.
